title: THE UNDERCROFT BELT EDITS ALL FOUR GUN KEYS
why: The four-gun belt, build 4 (his order of 2026-10-09: guns on keys 1 to 4, and the player can load up the belt with any gun he wants). On the Undercroft floor a gun in his hands could only trade places with the other gun: dropped on any other key it was refused with words saying keys 1 and 2 were his two guns. Now it binds the gun to that key in his plan, the way the Stash screen belt does, and what he had on that key goes to the key the gun came from; on key 3 or 4 the key it left fills as the raid start does, so the floor still shows exactly the keys the raid starts on. The Stash screen belt showed a bare number on keys 1 to 4 he had not bound; it now shows the gun the floor belt has there, dimmed. And decision D3: after an extraction the guns on keys 1 and 2 (in his hands or in the backpack) are gun 1 and gun 2 at home, instead of the best gun in his hands by tier; every other gun goes home as before.
now: The Undercroft belt puts a gun on any key, the Stash screen belt shows the gun keys, and the guns on keys 1 and 2 come home as gun 1 and gun 2.
